newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates stable on fund injection hope.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates stable on fund injection hope.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates were stable at midday on Friday despite rising payroll demand on hopes the central bank would inject postal fund interests of T$5.5 billion on Friday or Saturday, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate was at 5.003 percent against Thursday's 4.928 close, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 4.90-5.00. Dealers said rates should slide slightly next week as T$45 billion worth of NCDs and treasury bills will mature later this month to fuel the market.
Bond yields fell slightly after early buying, with the 10-year 84/1 at 5.656-660 against 5.665. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
